responsibility: Defines the PA-RISC RTL operand predicates used by instruction recognition and expanders in pa.md. It classifies immediates, registers, symbolic operands, legal memory forms, comparison operators, shift/add masks, TLS symbol kinds, PIC labels, and reload-sensitive operand forms using PA-specific legality tests and helper functions from pa.cc, thereby providing the semantic operand tests that distinguish which RTL shapes each PA pattern can accept.
